title: Ultimate Youtube Mod
description: This mod will add various, iconic Youtube related things, like youtubers, subscribe buttons, subscribe wood, etc.
body:
Ultimate YouTube Mod

A large Minecraft content mod inspired by YouTube's creators, history, memes, trends, and iconic moments.

The Ultimate YouTube Mod brings the world of YouTube into Minecraft with hundreds of custom additions, ranging from collectible items and decorative blocks to structures, music, and references from across the platform.

Whether you're a fan of classic YouTube, modern creators, or internet culture, this mod is designed to let you experience YouTube in an entirely new way.

Overview

![ ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0b2e72fd5b9d654104c96b60eaca34dc078fb9ec_0.webp)

Explore a growing collection of YouTube-inspired content including:

Custom blocks,
Decorative items,
Collectibles,
Play Buttons,
New structures,
Villagers,
Biomes,
Music Discs,
Internet-themed items,
Hidden references, and easter eggs.

Featured Content

![ ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6ca447a86169eee77f3e3669d6b9f4aa9b7a788e_0.webp)

🟥 Play Buttons

Earn and collect multiple YouTube-inspired Play Buttons, including:

Silver,
Gold,
Diamond, and
Ruby.

Display your achievements with decorative trophies inspired by YouTube's creator awards.

Meet Familiar Faces

![ ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e6d8d20cba363e1da715db1c0d674f22bb94f5d3_0.webp)

Discover content inspired by YouTube creators.

The Alpha currently contains 11 creators, with dozens more planned for future updates.

Each creator features unique references, items, and collectibles.

Explore New Places

![ ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/da4aca018f7a8bcf60a3a6316065a09f51be3905.png)![ ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/904d3882e0b85d3a63187355eeb18e17256bcadf.png)![ ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/37a85a0890f7c7a86777efbc4da0912f116108c6.png)![ ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4c765c23e4bbe54d52e37b5ad586d3293cae7d3c.png)![ ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f045d9393221b39f2f6e461fed99f05beea84c4c.png)

Travel through new YouTube-themed environments including:

Subscribe Biome,
YouTube Structures,
Hidden Locations, and
Easter Eggs

Every update expands the world with even more places to discover.

Collect Everything

![ ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/68ab46a5df346d54fe57f5d1970686e6a91f657a.png)

Find and collect dozens of unique items including:

Subscribe Buttons,
Like Buttons,
Dislike Buttons,
Internet Chips,
YouTube Paper,
Subscribe Wood,
Money,
Troll Chests,
and much more.

Music

![ ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c64950b4bca656d11b8d17aea801dfe05be01edd.png)

Collect music discs inspired by internet culture and memorable YouTube moments while exploring the world.

📖 Tuber-Dex

![ ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/31faa85352e45c36da29624064df551042ad2346.png)![ ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7ef20359d0b6a314d810b523560d684f81af0d16.png)

The Tuber-Dex is an item encyclopedia that contains every YouTube channel featured in the Ultimate YouTube Mod.

The Tuber-Dex currently features 54 available slots, allowing the mod to grow over time as more creators are added throughout development.

Features
📺 Browse every YouTube channel included in the mod.
📚 54 available channel slots.
🔍 Quickly view all featured creators in one place.
🚧 More channels will be added as development continues.

The Tuber-Dex is designed to become the complete collection of creators featured in the Ultimate YouTube Mod.

Current Status

The Ultimate YouTube Mod is currently in Alpha.

Current progress includes:

✅ Over 215 mod elements
✅ 11 YouTubers implemented
✅ Multiple structures
✅ New biome
✅ Play Buttons
✅ Decorative blocks
✅ Collectibles

More YouTubers, structures, dimensions, items, mobs, and secrets are planned for future updates.

Planned Features

Future updates will continue expanding the mod with:

More YouTubers
More structures
Additional biomes
More collectibles
New bosses
More music
More easter eggs
Even more YouTube history

💡 Looking for the recommended experience? Try the Ultimate YouTube Modpack (https://modrinth.com/modpack/ultimate-youtube-mod-modpack), which includes performance enhancements, shaders, multiplayer support, and quality-of-life improvements.

Thank you for downloading the mod and supporting its development. Your feedback and suggestions will help shape future updates!
